source_revisions.bounded_conclusion: Code implements the advertised steady-state mappings closely enough to define a manual controlled experiment, but the public artifact does not independently substantiate the paper's evaluation effect sizes or production transfer.

issues: paper_promises further repository data and analysis but none were located
headless/default-HRTF initialization depends on GUI construction
HRTF 50ms smoother is advanced once per block and is block-size dependent
benchmark has no correctness assertions and reuses recursively processed input
custom IR state stores an absolute nonportable file path
ParameterMapping gain endpoint comment says -14.3dB while formula and paper give approximately -26dB

knowledge_cards.claim: Paper-to-code formula correspondence does not reproduce or independently verify a listening-test effect size.
A deterministic macro must enumerate every derived control, including room size damping and HRTF blend in this implementation.
GUI-dependent DSP-resource initialization is unsafe for headless and automated rendering.
A sample-count smoother advanced once per block has block-size-dependent real-time duration.
A CPU timing benchmark without assertions or reference output is not a signal-quality validation.
Repository code licence and third-party bundled-asset redistribution rights must be checked separately.
The implemented gain formula and paper agree at approximately -26dB even though the adjacent source comment is wrong.

rule_revisions.apply_when: A non-lead source intentionally needs a rear-plane move and a level-only move has been judged insufficient
rule_revisions.change: Enable one preregistered coupled non-level cue bundle while holding the target direct attenuation equal between A and B
rule_revisions.verification: randomized section-specific full-mix A/B with identical target direct attenuation and global BS.1770 matching
rule_revisions.cancel_when: effect is loudness-only inconsistent HRTF-dependent or damages a protected quality

planned_experiments.material: project-owned verse and chorus with one intentionally rear-plane non-lead source
planned_experiments.a: level-only control at -9.2dB target direct attenuation with current EQ reverb and predelay
planned_experiments.b: same direct attenuation plus d=0.10 bundle: shelf -1.4dB at 7.122kHz wet 14 percent predelay 3ms low-mid +0.25dB at 300Hz Q1; HRTF off
planned_experiments.loudness_match: global post-render trim of complete excerpts to within 0.1 LU integrated BS.1770 after preserving equal target direct attenuation
planned_experiments.success: B is consistently farther and at least as coherent in both sections without protected-quality regression and preference survives matching
planned_experiments.cancel: B is merely duller or wetter judgments reverse benefit is unlabelled playback-mode-specific or a protected quality regresses
